notes: The italicized to them is added under rule 103; the alternative discontinuous reading is named in the unit note.

Both τοῖς πνευματικοῖς and τοῖς σαρκικοῖς read the article's way under rule 102: the article takes the supplied nominal things, the adjective stands bare, and in the first the determiner slot is separately displaced by αὐτῶν → their under rule 20.
